notes.title: Get 20% Off The Butterfly Dreams for Steam Summer Sale
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, dreamers.[/p][p][/p][p]We are joining Steam Summer Sale with a 20% discount. Yet the discount period is, too, ethereal. You have until July 10 to get this special price.[/p][p][/p][p]As a special present, we present to you an illustration made by our sprite artist Asteriesling.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297955/0f7a1288266a9be48a32d7e3f3d140eb0ca5bf4d.png"][/img]

Thank you and we hope you enjoy the dream.[/p]
